summary: Following recent midterm elections, statehood advocates say new momentum is building for DC's cause. The headlines highlight arguments that DC's population exceeds that of some states and document recent instances in which the site says DC's local authority has faced attack, alongside a statement on the current state of the statehood effort. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no senators, and their one delegate to the House cannot vote on the House floor.
